title: Winter and Spring at the Playground
text:
In winter, the playground is cold and quiet. The children wear warm coats, hats and gloves. Today there is snow on the slide and the swings. Tom and Lucy build a big snowman near the bench.

In spring, the playground is full of children again. The trees have green leaves, and the flowers are yellow and red. Lucy likes to play on the swings. Tom likes to run fast on the grass.

questions.text: What do the children wear in winter?
What color are the flowers in spring?
Why is the playground quiet in winter?
options: It is closed for the whole year
Few children want to play outside in the cold

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel in spring?

vocabulary.definition: a figure of a person made from piled-up snow
the season between winter and summer

paragraph_translations: No inverno, o parquinho é frio e silencioso. As crianças usam casacos quentes, chapéus e luvas. Hoje há neve no escorregador e nos balanços. Tom e Lucy fazem um boneco de neve grande perto do banco.

Na primavera, o parquinho fica cheio de crianças novamente. As árvores têm folhas verdes, e as flores são amarelas e vermelhas. Lucy gosta de brincar nos balanços. Tom gosta de correr rápido na grama.
